sources.title: chiru112/ec-knn-v3 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: CPU-only enzyme EC prediction for the Leak CURBER enzyme classification task. MMseqs2 search of each unique input against the full training set (prebuilt index), then a bit-score-weighted vote over the ECs of the top hits.
